errors.claim: Combat power's tangible factors include materiel.
errors.source_check: The combat-power passage names superior numbers; materiel appears only in the broader physical-forces discussion.

errors.claim: Persistent action is a means of fighting effectively despite friction.
errors.source_check: The source says persistent strength of mind and spirit, not persistent action.

errors.claim: The MAGTF component list includes a ground combat element and an aviation combat element.
errors.source_check: The source names ground and aviation elements; it does not add 'combat' to those two component names.

errors.claim: A gap may be a unit vulnerable in unsuitable terrain.
errors.source_check: The source specifically gives an infantry unit caught unprepared in open terrain; unsuitable terrain is a broader generalisation.
